//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the tooltip component. See ../README.md and button.json/card.json for the model. Tooltip is ATTRIBUTE-DRIVEN: a trigger element (both wrappers use <span>) carries class="pa-tooltip [modifiers]" and data-tooltip="<text>"; the bubble is a CSS ::before/::after pseudo-element (no static markup) OR a JS-portaled .pa-tooltip-floating <div> built on hover (OUT OF SCOPE — pre-JS-hook SSR only). Goldens capture ONLY the static trigger element.

propsVocabulary.text: tooltip text — rendered into the data-tooltip attribute on the trigger
propsVocabulary.position: end|bottom|start — logical placement; top is the default and emits NO class (core defines no pa-tooltip--top)
propsVocabulary.variant: colour variant (primary|success|warning|danger|color-1..9) — colours the bubble + arrow
propsVocabulary.multiline: boolean — allow the bubble text to wrap (fixed width) instead of single-line
propsVocabulary.help: boolean — cursor: help (question-mark cursor) for informational hints
propsVocabulary.keyword: boolean — dotted underline + help cursor for inline term explanations

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet shape PLUS the one convention BOTH wrappers legitimately add over the static snippet: the trigger always carries pa-tooltip--floating. Both wrappers treat the JS-portaled bubble (.pa-tooltip-floating built on hover) as their canonical tooltip, and pa-tooltip--floating on the trigger suppresses the CSS ::before/::after pseudo so the two can't stack into a double tooltip. It is hardcoded in both (not a prop), exactly like button's type="button". The trigger element is <span> in both wrappers. data-tooltip carries the text (structural attr, no class). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (NOT components.json). `produces` is a class template with {value}; capability.mjs expands it and cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper's map + the scenario set. `produces: null` = structural/native (data-tooltip text attr, trigger content).

position.note: top is the default and emits no class — excluded from options

text.note: structural — rendered into the data-tooltip attribute

cssStateClasses.//: pa-tooltip--* classes in main.css that are NOT feature-driven props — applied by JS at runtime, or a wrapper-convention flag. capability.mjs treats these as legitimately unclaimed so they don't read as 'core added a feature nobody mapped'.
cssStateClasses.pa-tooltip--floating: wrapper/JS convention flag — suppresses the CSS pseudo tooltip when a JS-portaled .pa-tooltip-floating bubble is used; both wrappers hardcode it on the trigger (a goldenConvention, not a prop)
cssStateClasses.pa-tooltip--auto-flip-top: collision-flip class toggled by tooltips-popovers.js at runtime
cssStateClasses.pa-tooltip--auto-flip-bottom: collision-flip class toggled by tooltips-popovers.js at runtime
cssStateClasses.pa-tooltip--auto-flip-start: collision-flip class toggled by tooltips-popovers.js at runtime
cssStateClasses.pa-tooltip--auto-flip-end: collision-flip class toggled by tooltips-popovers.js at runtime
